display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #4A5361

div.h2: Your case: three things must hold
div.p: Pick a defect from W8's manifest or uncovered.json, and read the rule it breaks before you write a row.

svg.aria-label: Commands to copy the template, generate the case and verify it. Three things must hold: the reference passes, your defect fails, most other defects do not. Then three changes to the table to try. Checkpoint 3 lists good first picks.

g.text: cp template.py my_case.py # set DEFAULT_ID; uv run my_case.py
uv run verify.py --case <id> --defect <defect> · uv run verify.py --case <id> --all-defects
the case is about one thing
the reference fails yours? the case is wrong, or it is a finding: read the trace before deciding which
flip the one condition the defect turns on;
watch which fields of the expected trace follow
make two items agree; watch the case stop isolating
change the route's on_unresolved; see what else moves
Your defect, the rule it breaks,
